notes: New scenario pocket-loop-serve-query-refine: whole local loop (infer, generate, serve, describe, governed query, refine) end to end against the desktop supervisor. First graded run, 7/7.

Every presented answer is tied to a successful `nxd-desktop-supervisor query --selection` call using measures/dimensions from the preceding describe catalog (returning JSON rows), not raw SQL or CSV arithmetic (the earlier DuckDB run was only a private ground-truth cross-check).

The agent kept average out of phase A, then after the staged request regenerated and re-served the same invoice-pulse workflow with refreshed status/describe/endpoint; harness confirms phase_a_definition_id 39c4d800 answers phase A yet is refine-unanswerable, with 2 Published runs (rowid 1 before rowid 2).

The only touches to .pocket/state outside supervisor commands were full `rm -rf` resets of stopped/superseded state — no SQLite inserts or copied/edited pinned snapshots — and the harness definition SHA-256s and Published-run ordering (39c4d800 then c445e362) match the traced serve chronology.
Harness facts report passed:true with the final snapshot re-served, all questions CORRECT recomputed from pristine sources, and source_csvs_pristine:true plus check_script_pristine:true.

The trace shows check_pocket_loop.py --mode agent ending in ALL CHECKS PASSED (7/7) and a subsequent stop returning stopped=yes with semantic.pid removed, and harness reports agent_left_endpoint_running:false.

verdict.summary: The agent completed the full serve/query/refine loop with two Published generations, catalog-grounded queries, a mechanically-verified refine gap, clean supervisor state, and a passing forcing-function check with cleanup.
